visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with dark shoulder-length hair and a black face mask wearing a dark green t-shirt is kneeling. She holds an orange-handled striker and scrapes a ferrocerium rod over a wooden board on the ground. A bright spark ignites a small fire on a piece of tinder. Background shows blurred people and camping gear in a warm-lit venue. (2) A middle-aged man with glasses and a pink polo shirt is shown from the torso up. He strikes a rod, creating sparks that ignite a flame on a wooden base. A child is visible in the background sitting in a camping chair. (3) A series of fast cuts show different individuals—men and women of various ages—striking fire starters. A young man in a grey polo shirt, a man in a black cap, and a man in a yellow vest are seen in sequence. Each successfully ignites a flame on a wooden platform while kneeling or sitting. (4) More individuals are shown, including a woman in a white shirt and a man in a camouflage shirt and mask. They hold up the flaming pieces of wood or tinder toward the camera, smiling or looking satisfied. The environment remains a busy indoor expo with tents and camping equipment visible in the background. (5) Final shots show a man in a cowboy hat and a woman with glasses successfully lighting their fires. They both look directly at the camera with wide smiles, holding the ignited strikers/wood pieces.
